args.title: Read notification base URL from config in src/notifications/templates.ts
args.body: Proposed change in src/notifications/templates.ts: update BASE_URL to read from the application configuration service instead of process.env.PUBLIC_URL so that production password reset and notification emails use the correct configured base URL.

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email uses `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` defaulting to `http://localhost:3000` instead of reading from the application configuration service, leading to incorrect base URLs in production emails.
